system.description:
You have Advantage on Grapple contests. A creature you grapple can't take the Disengage action, and you move at your full speed while dragging it.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Spellblades, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.

rules.value: Grappler: a creature you grapple can't Disengage, and you move at full speed while dragging it.
